context.route: readers of criterion 2 (amendment readers); recorded by ORCH from the replies of four fresh reader agents

task.description: Translation readers of the wording amendment of REQ-113 (criterion 2, Amendment readers; decision 0079 item 7). Four fresh reader agents, each given only the pair file, no code and no Sai document; two rounds per language, a different reader each round. en: six pairs (now_closing, idea_panel_lead, now_idea_t, stat_on, demo_accuracy_note, now_idea_s). kk: two pairs (now_idea_s, now_closing). Recorded by ORCH from the replies, not rewritten.

result.summary: Criterion 2 amendment readers: MET. 2 rounds en (6 pairs) and 2 rounds kk (2 pairs), four distinct fresh readers, 0 real marks. en round 1 wrote MARK on pair 1 now_closing but in the same reply said the best verdict is no real addition (the Russian has the same content: launch date, invitation, finished products); the round 2 reader: YES, no mark. A mark means the translation added an offer of ordering, a price or a term, and the Russian says the same, so pair 1 is read as no mark (two readers agree on no addition); a rewrite would change nothing. No pair was rewritten between the rounds. kk stays FOR_NATIVE_SPEAKER (ISS-0127): the readers are agents, not native speakers.

rounds.en_round_1: 1 now_closing YES (MARK written, then withdrawn in the reason: no real addition); 2 idea_panel_lead YES; 3 now_idea_t NO (quality: ТЗ means technical specification; the requirements is vague); 4 stat_on YES (Working acceptable; Live or Active more natural); 5 demo_accuracy_note YES; 6 now_idea_s NO (quality: loses technical). Totals 4 YES, 2 NO, 0 real marks.
rounds.en_round_2: 1 YES; 2 YES (polish: opens a hint); 3 YES (acceptable; option: technical spec); 4 NO (quality: Working reads like in progress; better Operational or Running); 5 YES; 6 YES (acceptable; option: technical specification). Totals 5 YES, 1 NO, 0 MARK.
rounds.kk_round_1: 1 now_idea_s YES (ЖИ-аналитик slightly more usual than ЖИ-талдаушы, both fine); 2 now_closing YES (датасы is a calque; Іске қосу күні әзірге жоқ more natural). 2 YES, 0 NO, 0 MARK. Confidence medium.
rounds.kk_round_2: 1 now_idea_s YES (ЖИ standard, техникалық тапсырма (ТТ) the normal term); 2 now_closing YES (датасы acceptable; күні more native). 2 YES, 0 NO, 0 MARK. Confidence moderate to good.

quality_remarks: en now_idea_s and now_idea_t: readers say the requirements loses technical (technical specification); a wording option for a later round, not a mark; no criterion fails (en now_idea_s did not change in this amendment)
en stat_on Working: one reader NO (reads like in progress), one YES: not two readers agreeing, so no change; option Operational or Running
kk now_closing: both readers prefer күні to датасы; датасы was chosen because күні is in the word list Ц; stays for the native speaker (ISS-0127)

issues.text: kk now_idea_s and now_closing (and the other kk lines): not read by a native speaker; ISS-0127 stays open
